gaps: The statpack has no call-for-response cut; the 'Response Requested' entry is the strongest signal on this docket and its lift had to come from general knowledge rather than a committed number.

The CourtListener sidecar's daily limit was already exhausted when this cell started, so neither the Federal Circuit opinion nor the Dolby BIOs could be read; a per-cell budget or a provisioned copy of the opinion below would close that gap.
